channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE A
channel.desc:
2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They?ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel \"One Left\", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film \"Parasite,\" and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel \"Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982\" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel \"Diary of a Murderer\" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, \"Hysteria,\" as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, \"The Disaster Tourist\", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel \"Diary of a Murderer\" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, \"Hysteria,\" as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, \"The Disaster Tourist\", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

channel.desc: Chef Joseph Lidgerwood?s class is? A Little Too Special! A K-FOOD experience crafted like no other ? Now Open! As global interest in Korean culture continues to thrive, K-FOOD has become one of its most compelling pillars. And today, people aren?t just curious about how it tastes. They want to learn how it?s made. Joseph Lidgerwood, chef-owner of the Michelin two-star restaurant EVETT, is an Australian chef who has developed a deep connection to Korea?s traditional jang and its ingredients. Now, he?s ready to share what he calls the ?the true taste of Korea.? Each episode welcomes a new group of participants from around the world, learning the all-time favorites such as Korean fried chicken, jaeyuk bokkeum, ganjang gejang, godeungeo kimchijjim, and bajirak sujebi, all reimagined through Joseph?s unique style. The atmosphere in the kitchen, shaped by curiosity, focus, and genuine interaction between Joseph and his students, often becomes as memorable as the food they create. You?ll take home the recipes, of course. But what truly sets this class apart is the moments shared along the way, the laughter, the discoveries, and the way flavor bridges cultures. Experience the depth, joy, and creativity of K-FOOD in Joseph?s A Little Too Special: K-FOOD Class!

channel.desc: \"What would you say in Korean in a situation like this?\" Discover how to express yourself in various daily life situations in Korean, from greetings and making friends to making promises and ordering your favorite food. A comprehensive Korean program designed to teach Korean language through real-life situations! A global initiative featuring top performers. Benefit from clear and friendly explanations by Peter Vint, a British TV personality who mastered Korean himself. Engage in lively Korean language lessons taught by Korean-American idols Aaron and Alexa! Experience a delightful Korean language course that delves into culture, trends, and even generational nuances. Each lesson is a concise 10-minute package, including scenarios, explanations, and practical exercises. Enjoy short, yet entertaining content that will also provide insight into culture, trends, and generational diversity. With just a glance, you'll be able to speak Korean fluently. Embark on an enjoyable and refreshing journey through our Korean language course.

channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: K-CHAT: TRAVEL IN KOREA
channel.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, ?K-Chat: Travel in Korea? What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF?s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you?ll systematically improve your Korean!

channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE A
channel.desc:
2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They?ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel \"One Left\", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film \"Parasite,\" and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel \"Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982\" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel \"Diary of a Murderer\" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, \"Hysteria,\" as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, \"The Disaster Tourist\", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->
.

channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE A
channel.desc:
2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They?ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel \"One Left\", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film \"Parasite,\" and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel \"Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982\" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel \"Diary of a Murderer\" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, \"Hysteria,\" as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, \"The Disaster Tourist\", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: K-FOOD CLASS
channel.desc: Chef Joseph Lidgerwood?s class is? A Little Too Special! A K-FOOD experience crafted like no other ? Now Open! As global interest in Korean culture continues to thrive, K-FOOD has become one of its most compelling pillars. And today, people aren?t just curious about how it tastes. They want to learn how it?s made. Joseph Lidgerwood, chef-owner of the Michelin two-star restaurant EVETT, is an Australian chef who has developed a deep connection to Korea?s traditional jang and its ingredients. Now, he?s ready to share what he calls the ?the true taste of Korea.? Each episode welcomes a new group of participants from around the world, learning the all-time favorites such as Korean fried chicken, jaeyuk bokkeum, ganjang gejang, godeungeo kimchijjim, and bajirak sujebi, all reimagined through Joseph?s unique style. The atmosphere in the kitchen, shaped by curiosity, focus, and genuine interaction between Joseph and his students, often becomes as memorable as the food they create. You?ll take home the recipes, of course. But what truly sets this class apart is the moments shared along the way, the laughter, the discoveries, and the way flavor bridges cultures. Experience the depth, joy, and creativity of K-FOOD in Joseph?s A Little Too Special: K-FOOD Class!

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Martina Consonni - Schumann e Chopin
channel.desc: Nello splendido contesto della Casa degli Atellani di Milano, la giovane pianista comasca Martina Consonni esegue Papillons op.2 \(1831\) di Schumann e Scherzo in si bemolle minore op.31 n.2 \(1837\) di Chopin \(Milano, 2022\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Generali 190: Persone e Storie - 1869
channel.desc: La storia delle Assicurazioni Generali dalla fondazione ai giorni nostri. Ogni puntata un decennio, un'avventura, un protagonista - 1869: Pasquale Revoltella - Le Generali e il Canale di Suez.

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: sempreVerdi - Verdi e le donne
channel.desc: Ottava puntata della serie SempreVerdi, intitolata 'Verdi e le donne', in cui il verdiano Giuseppe Martini racconta le figure femminili che hanno circondato e influenzato la vita del compositore \(2015\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Concerto dalla Odeonsplatz - parte 1
channel.desc: Wagner&Verdi - Concerto dalla meravigliosa Odeonsplatz di Monaco di Baviera con le due star della scena lirica Rolando Villazon e Thomas Hampson - Coro e Orchesra Sinfonica della Radio Bavarese - Y.N.Seguin, dir. \(2013\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Almanacco di Bellezza
channel.desc: Piero Maranghi, direttore di Sky Classica, passa in rassegna, anniversari e ricorrenze legati la mondo dell'arte, della cultura, della storia e dello sport. In studio con lui, il collezionista ed esperto d'arte Leonardo Piccinini.

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Adams - The Gospel according
channel.desc: ...to the other Mary: Opera-oratorio \(2012\) in due atti su libretto di Peter Sellars - con T.Mumford, K.O'Connor, P.Hoare, D.Bubeck, B.Cummings - Berliner Philharmoniker - Rundfunkchor Berlin - Simon Rattle, dir. \(2017\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Pianisti - L' Accademia di Imola, ep.8
channel.desc: Sfide': ottava puntata della serie Pianisti che svela i dietro le quinte dell'Accademia di Imola: attivita', grandi concerti, sfide, tensione e dedizione - con il pianista Andre' Gallo - G.De Stefano, reg. \(2015\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Mestiere Teatro
channel.desc: Un viaggio alla scoperta di quanti nei teatri, lontano dalla ribalta, in ufficio, nei laboratori, dietro le quinte, nella buca, lavorano per la riuscita e il successo di uno spettacolo. A cura di Paolo Gavazzeni.

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Prokof'ev - Il giocatore
channel.desc: Opera in quattro atti \(1929\) tratto dal romanzo di Dostoevskij - con V.Ogonovenko, K.Opolais, M.Didyk, S.Toczyska, S.Ruegamer - Staatkapelle Berlin - Daniel Barenboim, dir. - Dmitrij Tcherniakov, reg. \(Berlino, 2008\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Il giocatore - backstage
channel.desc: Dietro le quinte dello Staatsoper di Berlino alla scoperta dell'opera di Prokof'ev nell'allestimento di Dmitrij Tcherniakov - con V.Ogonovenko, K.Opolais, D.Barenboim, E.Zaitseva \(Berlino, 2008\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Al presente - Nicola Campogrande ''R
channel.desc: Uno speciale approfondimento dedicato a Nicola Campogrande \(Torino, 1969\) compositore, direttore artistico e critico, qui alle prese di 'R. \(Ritratto per pianoforte e orchestra\)' - a cura di A.Daveri \(Milano, 2013\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: La Classica domanda - Lillo e Greg
channel.desc: Proseguono le interviste condotte da Anton Giulio Onofri a personalita' del mondo della cultura, dell'arte e dello spettacolo. Ospite della Classica domanda di oggi e' il duo comico composto da Lillo e Greg \(2013\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Pushing Borders
channel.desc: Tre coreografie si uniscono in Pushing Borders: 'Breathe' di Milla Koistinen, 'If You Could See Me Now' di Arno Schuitemaker e 'On Earth I'm Done: Mountains' di Jefta van Dinther con Stein Fluijt, Milla Koistinen \(2022\).

channel.name: Classica IT

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Beethoven - Sinfonia n.9
channel.desc: Sinfonia in re minore, op.125, detta Corale \(1824\) - con C.Oelze, soprano - A.Peebo, mezzosoprano - S.O'Neill, tenore - D. Henschel, baritono - Deutscher Kammerchor - Kammerphilharmonie Bremen - P.Jarvi dir. \(Bonn, 2009\).

Lorsque le Hamas a pris le pouvoir ? Gaza, Isra?l et l'?gypte ont impos? un blocus sur le territoire, qui h?berge 2 millions de personnes. Plus de 40 % ont moins de 15 ans et le ch?mage des jeunes s'?l?ve ? plus de 60 %. Certains qualifient la bande de Gaza comme la plus grande prison au monde. Le documentaire se penche sur les r?alit?s de Gaza aujourd'hui ? et le r?le vital de la minorit? chr?tienne au service de son prochain. (30 minutes).

channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Kansai Deeper
channel.desc: Takoyaki, or octopus-filled balls, are a popular food associated with Osaka Prefecture. The flexible recipe has engendered its own food culture and become a leading Osakan \"soul food.\" Master cooks are particular about their grill, flour, sauce, and the speed with which they turn the balls. Takoyaki features daily on social media with novelty goods and photos of takoyaki parties. Explore the evolving world of takoyaki and glimpse the essence of Osakans who prize tasty, affordable and satisfying food.

channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Kansai Deeper
channel.desc: Takoyaki, or octopus-filled balls, are a popular food associated with Osaka Prefecture. The flexible recipe has engendered its own food culture and become a leading Osakan \"soul food.\" Master cooks are particular about their grill, flour, sauce, and the speed with which they turn the balls. Takoyaki features daily on social media with novelty goods and photos of takoyaki parties. Explore the evolving world of takoyaki and glimpse the essence of Osakans who prize tasty, affordable and satisfying food.

channel.desc: The Ryusen-ji Temple in Tenkawa Village is known for its mountain ascetic practices. The pond, where ascetics purify themselves, is silent and still amidst the snow. channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Darwin's Amazing Animals
channel.desc: The dry season is a desperate time in the African savanna. Herds of wild animals join great migrations in search of food and water. But that's not always the case for the lucky ones in Tanzania's Ruaha National Park. An incredible symbiotic relationship has formed between animals and plants, resulting in a year-round home for all. Our team travels to the 20,000-square-kilometer nature reserve in East Africa to discover what makes Ruaha National Park such a wondrous paradise.

channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Time Lapse Journey
channel.desc: Nikko, in Tochigi Prefecture, is home to much natural beauty with its great mountains and lakes. Located at a convenient distance from Tokyo, many come to escape from the summer heat. The ornate Nikko Toshogu Shrine is a popular spiritual place. See the widely beloved Nikko through time-lapse photography.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: Green Wood Robbery
channel.desc: Berlatar di masa-masa awal Republik Tiongkok, keluarga Kang yang kaya dibunuh dengan sadis dan putri mereka hilang secara misterius. Selama puluhan tahun, arwah di rumah Kang di Green Wood Lane masih menghantui.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: Model Family
channel.desc: Yu Xiang dan putrinya pindah ke sebuah lingkungan baru yang kehidupan warganya tampak sempurna. Namun, sejumlah rahasia gelap dan mengerikan mulai menimpa setiap keluarga di sana.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: Tales Of The Undeparted
channel.desc: Delapan anggota AKB48 berkumpul di sebuah kuil untuk membagikan kisah pribadi yang paling misterius dan menyeramkan, seperti cerita hantu, legenda urban, atau aktivitas gaib yang beredar di masyarakat Jepang.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: 3AM
channel.desc: Sekelompok teman mengalami serangkaian peristiwa supranatural saat pergi berkemah di dalam sebuah hutan nan angker. Siapakah yang berhasil lolos dari hutan saat fajar tiba?

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: The Revenge
channel.desc: Ruo Wei kembali ke rumah masa kecilnya bersama dua sahabatnya, dan bertemu kembali dengan sepupunya. Saat mereka ingin menikmati perjalanan, mereka terus dihantui oleh sejumlah peristiwa supranatural nan menakutkan.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: Hollow
channel.desc: Beth, seorang lansia penderita Alzheimer, pindah ke sebuah rumah baru bersama keluarga putrinya. Di tengah gejalanya yang kian memburuk, Beth berhasil mengungkap sesuatu nan mengerikan yang mengamati setiap gerakannya.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: Behave
channel.desc: Setelah kematian seorang teman, sekelompok remaja pergi ke sebuah vila nan misterius di pinggiran kota London. Mereka harus mengungkap rahasia gelap vila itu di tengah meningkatnya sejumlah peristiwa nan meresahkan.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: Detrimental
channel.desc: Seorang pria tunanetra, You Ji Ren, bekerja di sebuah pabrik di pulau terpencil. Karena badai, pabrik itu terisolasi dan muncul sesosok monster yang membuat siapa pun berubah menjadi bayangan hitam jika melihatnya.

channel.name: Thrill ID
channel.title: Midnight Ruins
